killedBy: the persistence controls (issue #249) ARMS Reset Developer Data, and a cancelled confirmation changes nothing
why: Erases developer data on a single press, with no confirmation and no way to cancel. Issue #249's sixth criterion names cancellation first among the cases tests must cover, and a destructive control one click from firing in a pane a developer is working in is the shape the two-press arm exists for -- the same one Reset stats and Reset progress already use.
